proceso: Catacumbas · relicario: master → 3D (sello y alma en Blender)

pasos.prompt: Game prop design of a royal reliquary that holds the soul of a king, for an isometric escape room game in a medieval fantasy castle. A small rectangular chest-shaped reliquary of gold and dark wood with a FLAT lid (not domed), the lid slightly overhanging, four short gold feet, gold corner fittings with round rivets, a simple round gold medallion on the front (no symbols). Closed. Chunky simple bold shapes, no fine filigree, no gems, no text. Seen in a three-quarter front view slightly from above, whole object visible and centered, symmetrical. Exactly the same stylized 3D toon rendering, soft shading, saturated colors and soft upper-left lighting as the reference chest. Edges defined only by light and shading, no outline. Isolated on a flat uniform light grey background, no floor, no shadow, no text.
